# Phase 0 handoff

Phase 0 (Foundation) of [`15-build-plan.md`](../../spec/15-build-plan.md), committed on `main`.

## Gate

- `make build lint test` passes: UI build, Go build, golangci-lint (0 issues), Biome, `tsc`, the em dash check, every Go package with `-race` on SQLite and Postgres (testcontainers), and Vitest.
- `hangar server` starts, `/healthz` answers `{"status":"ok"}` and `/readyz` answers `{"status":"ready"}`; `hangar healthcheck` exits 0.
- Every interface has a fake in a `<pkg>test` package with its own tests. Coverage is above the 13-testing.md floors in every package (`make cover`).
- Also passing: `make test-compat` (Go and pytest launchers), Playwright shell tests with axe at three widths, `make check-generate`, govulncheck, actionlint.

## What exists

| Area | Where |
|---|---|
| Domain types | `internal/model` |
| Configuration: keys, defaults, YAML, `HANGAR_*`, `--set`, validation of every error, first-start secrets, reference | `internal/config`, `docs/reference/configuration.md` |
| Database: bun for SQLite and Postgres, migrations for every table, models, transactions, SQLite single-process lock | `internal/db`, `internal/db/migrations/{sqlite,postgres}` |
| Test databases | `internal/db/dbtest`: `SQLite(t)`, `Postgres(t)`, `ForEachDriver(t, fn)` |
| Telemetry: exporters, resource, logs with trace IDs, every instrument in 11 | `internal/telemetry` |
| HTTP plumbing: request IDs, recovery, access log, auth hook, Hub and RFC 9457 errors, trusted proxies, body limits, escaped-path helpers, signed URLs, health, protocol dispatcher | `internal/httpx` |
| Secret encryption with the Instance key | `internal/secrets` |
| Native API contract and generated server, models, client | `api/openapi.yaml`, `internal/api/gen`, `ui/src/api/schema.d.ts` |
| Web UI scaffold with every page shell | `ui/`, embedded by `internal/web` |
| Server and commands: `server`, `worker`, `config reference`, `config validate`, `healthcheck`, `admin migrate`, `version` | `cmd/hangar` |
| Compatibility harness and fixtures | `compat/` |
| CI | `.github/workflows/{ci,compat,fuzz,codeql,release-please}.yml` |

[`interface-coverage.md`](../interface-coverage.md) maps each Hub, git and Xet requirement to these methods, and lists the methods phase 0 added to the interfaces in 02.

## Notes for phase 1

- Commands: `make build`, `make lint`, `make test` (needs Docker for Postgres; set `HANGAR_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN` to use your own server), `make test-compat`, `make generate` and `make check-generate`, `make cover`, `make fuzz`, `make e2e` (against `HANGAR_URL`), `make dev`.
- Toolchain: Go 1.27.2; Node 24 (`ui/.nvmrc`) with `corepack pnpm` (pnpm 11.28.2). On a machine whose default Node is older, put Node 24 first on `PATH`.
- Database tests: use `dbtest.ForEachDriver(t, func(t *testing.T, d *db.DB) {...})` so every test runs on SQLite and Postgres. Times in SQL comparisons are safe on SQLite because bun writes them in one UTC format.
- Integration tests go in `*_integration_test.go` with the `integration` build tag; `make test` includes them.
- Compat suites: Go tests take the `compat` build tag and use `compat/harness.Start`; pytest suites use the `hangar` and `hf_endpoint` fixtures from `compat/conftest.py`.
- The native API router validates parameter types but not ranges; check limits in handlers. Add the route template middleware pattern from `cmd/hangar/router.go` if you build your own router, so logs and spans use templates.
- `cmd/hangar` wires fakes for everything except the database, health and the UI; the integration lead replaces them in phase 2.
- Decisions and open questions: [`decisions.md`](../decisions.md).

## Known gaps

- `release.yml` and `docs.yml` are not written: GoReleaser, the Dockerfile, the Helm chart and MkDocs belong to W9. `make image` and `make docs` need W9's `Dockerfile` and `mkdocs.yml`.
- CodeQL, release-please and the workflows have only been linted locally (actionlint); they first run when the repository is on GitHub.
- The CLI client commands (`login`, `pull`, `push` and the rest) are W9's; `cmd/hangar` has the server and admin commands only.
- `dependabot.yml`, issue templates and the other repository files in 12 are W9's.
